meta.name: capacity-planning
meta.description: Analyze team capacity, plan resource allocation, and balance workload across projects. Forecast staffing needs and optimize team utilization while maintaining sustainable pace.

copy.tagline: 分析团队容量，规划资源分配，平衡工作负载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理团队工作负载并优化资源利用率
copy.tagline_en: Analyze team capacity, plan resource allocation, and balance workload
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage team workload and optimize resource utilization

howto.what: 分析团队容量，规划资源分配，平衡跨项目工作量，并根据最佳实践（如85%利用率、考虑空闲和会议）给出优化建议。
howto.when: 当进行年度或季度规划、分配人员到项目、调整团队规模等时触发。

say.text: 我们团队有5人，下个季度要交付三个项目，请做容量规划。
say.note: Claude将计算可用工时并给出资源分配建议。

say.text: 当前团队利用率太高，请帮我平衡工作量。
say.note: Claude会检查瓶颈并建议调整，如增加人手或重新分配任务。

howto.what_en: Analyze team capacity, plan resource allocation, balance workload across projects, and provide optimization recommendations based on best practices (e.g., 85% utilization, accounting for meetings and overhead).
howto.when_en: Triggered when doing annual or quarterly planning, allocating people to projects, adjusting team size, etc.

say_en.text: Our team has 5 members and three projects next quarter. Please do capacity planning.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate available hours and suggest resource allocation.

say_en.text: Current utilization is too high. Help me balance workload.
